name: Preseason
h: HAVOC Rifle.

name: Wild Frontier
h: Octane debuts as the first post-launch Legend. First Battle Pass starts the seasonal model. Legendary Hunt event.

name: Battle Charge
h: Wattson debuts. L-STAR energy LMG. Ranked Leagues become a permanent ladder. Challenges.

name: Meltdown
h: Crypto debuts with a surveillance drone. Charge Rifle. World's Edge arrives as the first new battle royale map.

name: Assimilation
h: Revenant debuts as an aggressive assassin. Sentinel sniper rifle. Major landmark updates to World's Edge.

name: Fortune's Favor
h: Loba debuts. Seasonal Quests begin with The Broken Ghost. Kings Canyon rotation changes.

name: Boosted
h: Rampart debuts. Volt SMG. Crafting system with replicators.

name: Ascension
h: Horizon debuts. New map: Olympus. Clubs system for team identity and social play.

name: Mayhem
h: Fuse debuts. 30-30 Repeater. Kings Canyon is destroyed and reshaped with new destructible points of interest.

name: Legacy
h: Valkyrie debuts. Bocek Bow. Arenas launches as a permanent round-based mode. Infested Olympus.

name: Emergence
h: Seer debuts with heartbeat intel. Rampage LMG. Ranked Arenas. World's Edge: Talos Reborn. Chronicles.

name: Escape
h: Ash debuts. C.A.R. SMG. New map: Storm Point, the largest battle royale map at the time.

name: Defiance
h: Mad Maggie debuts. Control mode introduced. Broad Olympus updates.

name: Saviors
h: Newcastle debuts. Storm Point changes. Major ranked scoring updates.

name: Hunted
h: Vantage debuts. Kings Canyon overhauled with new rotations. Level cap progression expanded.

name: Eclipse
h: Catalyst debuts. New map: Broken Moon. Gift system and stickers.

name: Revelry
h: No new Legend. Class rework: perks for Assault, Skirmisher, Recon, Controller and Support go live. Team Deathmatch joins Mixtape.

name: Arsenal
h: Ballistic debuts. Weapon Mastery progression. Ranked structure updates. World's Edge changes.

name: Resurrection
h: Revenant Reborn: full Revenant rework (no new Legend). Charge Rifle refresh. Loot, ranked and ring tuning. New Broken Moon maps for Mixtape.

name: Ignite
h: Conduit debuts with shield support. Storm Point updates. Cross progression. Crafting rotation changes.

name: Breakout
h: No new Legend. Legend Upgrade System (in-match perk choices). Armor and progression modernized. Ranked updates. Thunderdome map for Mixtape.

name: Upheaval
h: Alter debuts with void-based traversal. Apex Artifacts. Class matchup balancing. Broken Moon changes.

name: Shockwave
h: No new Legend. New map: E-District. Akimbo pistols. System-wide weapon balancing.

name: From the Rift
h: No new Legend. Lifeline rework. Support class updates for revive-focused play. Back-to-core gameplay focus.

name: Takeover
h: No new Legend. Ash and Ballistic buffs. Expanded Assault class upgrades. Midseason legend-parity balancing.

name: Prodigy
h: Sparrow debuts. Pathfinder buffs. Movement and engagement-flow improvements.

name: Showdown
h: No new Legend. Wildcard mode. Bangalore and Caustic buffs. Weapon and class tuning for late-game pressure.

name: Amped
h: No new Legend. Olympus map updates. Legend buffs (Horizon, Rampart, Valkyrie) and weapon tuning. Ranked split adjustments.

name: Breach
h: No new Legend. Hardlight Mesh destructible cover. Fuse, Catalyst and Bloodhound changes. Shotgun buffs, marksman nerfs. 7th Anniversary event. Audio customization overhaul.

name: Overclocked
h: Axle debuts (Skirmisher). Twin Razors mythic melee weapon. Deathbox Respawns. Chain Healing options. Vantage and Conduit buffs; Alter nerfs.

name: Marked
h: No new Legend. Bloodhound rework with new ultimate, Allfather's Cloak. Three new World's Edge POIs. Regenerating energy-weapon ammo. Corrupted Attachments. Loba and Rampart buffs; Valkyrie, Axle and Seer nerfs. Five-day ranked ladders.

name: Cipher
h: No new Legend. Crypto rework (drone battery, persistent marks, faster EMP). Lifeline and Revenant buffs; Loba and Axle nerfs. E-District Night map. Akimbo Wingman, Hemlok returns, L-STAR back in floor loot. Two Legend bans in Diamond+ ranked.
